ideas.pitch: A rigorous code screening tool built for solo hiring assessments that evaluates candidate submissions using Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) comparison and algorithmic complexity profiling.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 & Finalist Coding Challenges for Solo Hiring Hackathon
ideas.title: RecruitAI Screen: Automated Code Quality & AST Diff Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is a hiring hackathon organized by WorkElate, building a tool that helps recruiters instantly grade and screen code submissions targets the exact pain point of the organizing company.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered cybersecurity assistant that scans incoming pull requests for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and instantly generates validated secure code patches.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity and Software Engineering Competency Evaluation
ideas.title: SecGuard AI: Automated Vulnerability Remediation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Cybersecurity is explicitly highlighted as a key specialization for eligible candidates, and judges from a tech hiring platform will appreciate practical code-safety tooling.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined machine learning assistant that takes raw CSV datasets, automatically handles missing values, detects feature drift, and builds baseline predictive models in minutes.
ideas.problem_statement: Data Science and AI/ML Specialization Assessment
ideas.title: DataFlow ML: Automated Feature Engineering Pipeline for Tabular Data
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the Data Science and AI/ML graduation criteria by demonstrating rigorous end-to-end data processing rather than a generic prompt wrapper.

ideas.pitch: An interactive technical skill verification dashboard that aggregates candidate GitHub metrics, algorithmic problem-solving speed, and verified project contributions into a unified hiring profile.
ideas.problem_statement: Screening and Technical Skill Assessment for Emerging Talent
ideas.title: SkillMatrix: Real-Time Technical Competency Mapping Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with WorkElate's core mission of identifying and filtering emerging software engineering talent through comprehensive technical profiling.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight log-ingestion and anomaly detection dashboard that flags suspicious access patterns and unauthorized endpoints using rolling statistical thresholds.
ideas.title: LogSentinel: Real-Time Network Threat Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates deep systems knowledge and handles a complex problem domain within the tight constraints of a solo overnight coding challenge.
